info.description: The direct, key-authenticated DataFluxor scraper API and remote MCP endpoint. Browser workspace requests use the separately authenticated /v1 gateway and are not a substitute for these public endpoints. Available public scraper tools can be used through the API, MCP and CLI when the deployment offers them. Every plan includes every tool and the workspace. Free includes 250 credits a month without a card; top-ups add purchased credits. Direct reads cost 1 credit and browser actions cost 5; keyword research, domain overview and backlinks (DataForSEO data) cost more, from 40 credits a request, and each operation states its price. Cached and failed work is free. Cached reads require a positive balance. Daily live-page, request rate and concurrency limits protect capacity. A refusal is 429 RATE_LIMITED or DAILY_LIVE_LIMIT, or 402 INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS, and charges nothing. FUT Data is a separate subscription with REST API access to the FUT endpoints only (tag FUT Data API); it has no MCP tools and no CLI commands. Requests are limited to 2 MiB. Invalid requests and requests that fail before useful collection do not consume a credit.

get.description: Stored prices for up to 500 card versions by EA item id. Each id maps to exactly one catalogued card or is returned in unresolved with a reason; a price is never borrowed from another version. FUT Data API reads serve the newer of the latest per-card read and the players-list price (price_source).

ResultV1Error.description: The error envelope of every /api/v1/scrape, /api/v1/fut and run endpoint: success false, a machine-readable code (branch on code, not on the error text), a human-readable error, latency_ms, timestamp and, where useful, request_id, retry_after_seconds, credit_cost and data. Other surfaces keep their own conventions: MCP answers with JSON-RPC errors (an invalid, revoked or missing API key is HTTP 401 with a WWW-Authenticate challenge on every method); OAuth endpoints (/oauth/register, /oauth/token) answer with RFC 6749 and RFC 7591 {error, error_description} and status 400 for invalid client metadata; the account endpoints under /api/v1/auth use {success, error, code}. Codes: INVALID_REQUEST (400), REQUEST_TOO_LARGE (413, body over 2 MiB), UNAUTHORIZED (401), FORBIDDEN (403), INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS (402), COUNTRY_UNSUPPORTED, LANGUAGE_UNSUPPORTED and DEVICE_UNSUPPORTED (422), TARGET_NOT_ALLOWED (400), TARGET_HTTP_ERROR, TARGET_UNREACHABLE, TARGET_UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT and TARGET_ROBOTS_DISALLOWED and FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE (422; a disabled option such as render, uncharged), RATE_LIMITED and DAILY_LIVE_LIMIT (429; cached results remain available with a positive balance, and Retry-After names when to retry), REQUEST_TIMEOUT, UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE, PROXY_EXHAUSTED and MARKET_MISMATCH (503; MARKET_MISMATCH: every results page obtained was produced for another country than the one requested, nothing is served or charged, retry after retry_after_seconds), RESULT_UNAVAILABLE (410 when retained or project evidence is gone; never a second charge), INTERNAL_ERROR (500).

credit_cost.description: Confirmed cost of the original outcome in credits under the schedule recorded for the run: 5 per Google results page fetched live, 0 per page served from cache, 1 per live autocomplete call or extracted page, 1 per page audited as HTML in a crawl; failed or undetermined work costs 0. Successful scoped replays return the original cost without charging it again. Omitted means the outcome is not confirmed, never an implied zero.

data.description: Diagnostics. On a capacity refusal: admitted (always false: nothing was started, reserved or charged), limit_type (request_rate, active_job_capacity, active_run_capacity, crawl_concurrency, search_capacity, google_pacing or deployment_pause), on a RATE_LIMITED refusal a subcode (REQUEST_RATE_LIMIT: the per-minute window is full; CONCURRENCY_LIMIT: too many jobs are running or waiting; the code itself stays RATE_LIMITED) and, where known, reason and scope (what is full: the credential, the organization shared by all its credentials and clients, or the platform). Some tools add partial data here.

field.description: On a rejected request, the input that is wrong, as a path from the request: project_id, items[2].metrics.difficulty. Absent when the problem is not one input.

hint.description: What to do about the error, when there is something specific to do.

item_index.description: On a rejected batch, the zero-based index of the entry that is wrong.

request_id.description: Correlation id, also sent as the X-Request-Id response header. Quote it to match a failure to server logs; it carries no credentials.

retry_after_seconds.description: Present on every retryable answer (429 and 503 with Retry-After); the same value as the Retry-After header, computed from real state (the earliest slot release, the request-rate window refill, or the search queue) and never a fixed guess. Wait this long, then repeat the identical request (with the same Idempotency-Key).

corrected_query.description: Set when the query as typed matched nothing and the cards are those of this spelling-corrected query.

accelerate.description: The text Futbin's players list prints under the height: on most cards the body type (Avg & Lean, Tall & Normal, a player's own body type), on others an AcceleRATE type (Controlled, Lengthy, Explosive). Not a reliable AcceleRATE value.

corrected.description: Fields (name, club, league, nation) replaced by EA's own values because the source page showed them wrong.

ea_id.description: EA item id; 0 when the card has no exact EA id.

holographic_type.description: EA's hologram type: pristine (Signature), holographic or none; null when not known yet.

in_game.description: False when the card's EA item id is not an item in the game (a retired or never released id) and the card never had a price; true when EA lists it; null otherwise.

last_price.description: Only when price is null: the most recent usable console price with its own time (at) and stale flag. Never the current price.

last_price_pc.description: Only when price_pc is null: the most recent usable PC price with its own time (at) and stale flag.

price.description: Best known console price: the newer of the per-card read (exact) and the players-list price. Null when unknown or replaced. Its stale flag turns only after 24 hours (quotes.*.stale turns after 15 minutes): trade on quotes or their age_seconds.

price_pc_no_market.description: True when price_pc is null because the market data showed the 15,000,000 maximum price for PC regardless of console price (ambiguous maximum).

price_unconfirmed.description: True when price is the last good console read because a newer read jumped (more than 5x, or the 15,000,000 maximum) and waits for a second read.

rarity_group.description: icon, hero, promo, gold, silver or bronze.

replaced.description: An old copy left by a club move; its price fields are null. replaced_by is the current card.

short_name.description: The name printed on the card, such as Vini Jr. or Pedri.

signature.description: True for a Signature (autographed) card: EA's pristine hologram. False for other cards; null when EA's facts for a holographic card are not known yet.

credit_cost.description: 1 on the FUT Data API (0 when a price request names only unknown ids); 0 for workspaces with FUT enabled.

no_market.description: PC only: the market data shows the 15,000,000 maximum price and is ambiguous regardless of console price; price is 0 and reason says why.

pending.description: No price is stored for this market yet.

price.description: Lowest buy-now listing in coins; 0 = the latest read found nothing listed.

price_source.description: FUT Data API reads: card = the latest per-card read (listings, range, futbin_updated_at belong to it); list = the newer players-list price (price and observed_at only).

stale.description: observed_at is more than 15 minutes old.

unconfirmed.description: Console only: the newest read jumped (more than 5x the last good read, or the 15,000,000 maximum) and waits for a second read. price and observed_at are the last good read; unconfirmed_price is the held read.

unconfirmed_price.description: The held console read when unconfirmed is true.
